submitted.rationale: Every Mg–Sb–O phase here (MgO, Mg-antimonates, MgSb2O6) has a band gap well above the 2.4 eV illumination, so little photoresponse was expected anywhere on the line. Five compositions spread across the line (Sb fraction 0.12–0.82) all gave EQE at noise level, about 0 ± 0.001%. Index 14 (Sb 0.39) had the highest value, -0.00004%, but it is not meaningfully different from the others.

rejected.reason: EQE -0.00063%; MgSb2O6 trirutile region, wide gap
